segments.speaker: David
segments.text: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness:

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
The foolish shall not stand in thy sight:

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing:

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

footnotes.text: + bloody…: Heb. man of bloods and deceit

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

footnotes.text: + thy holy…: Heb. the temple of thy holiness

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

footnotes.text: + mine…: Heb. those which observe me

segments.text: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth;
their inward part is very wickedness;
their throat is an open sepulchre;

footnotes.text: + their mouth: Heb. his mouth, that is, the mouth of any of them

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

footnotes.text: + defendest…: Heb. coverest over, or, protectest them

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
